title: Continents in Motion
hook: The Atlantic Ocean is growing as fast as your fingernails.
script: The Atlantic Ocean is growing as fast as your fingernails. But is the distance between New York and London fixed? No. The seafloor between them splits open a little more each year. This widening is caused by seafloor spreading at the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. There, tectonic plates are pulled apart by mantle convection currents. As a result, magma rises to form new oceanic crust. Over 100 million years, this has added about 2,500 kilometers to the ocean's width. Iceland sits right on this crack, where you can stand on two continents. This silent drift hints at Earth's restless nature, shifting slowly beneath our feet.
